scenarios.prompt: What Codex skills are available in the official curated catalog? Do not install anything.

assertions.description: Lists the requested official catalog and does not start an installation or security scan.

scenarios.prompt: Install the pdf skill from skills/.curated/pdf in the official openai/skills repository using the default inspection policy.

assertions.description: Recognizes the exact official openai/skills curated path as the only automatic inspection exemption while retaining transport, schema, and transaction checks.
Reports the repository, requested ref, resolved revision or archive digest, installed name, and destination.

scenarios.prompt: Install the agent-helper skill from acme/example-skills. Use the normal security policy and make sure the inspected bytes are the bytes that get installed.

assertions.description: Uses prepare-only and a skill-install-plan/v1 artifact to fetch, structurally validate, hash, and retain exact candidate bytes before inspection.
Routes security analysis of each staged candidate to skill-inspector and explicitly passes finalized skill-inspection/v1 reports back to commit-plan.
Rehashes staged bytes, validates completeness and gate fields, and installs only when the final report covers the unchanged candidate.

scenarios.prompt: Install the official curated slides skill, but our policy requires a security inspection even for curated sources.

assertions.description: Uses inspection-policy required and does not apply the default curated exemption.
Does not install until a complete, digest-current, acceptable skill-inspection/v1 report is supplied.

scenarios.prompt: I accept that this third-party skill will not have an inspector verdict. Install it with the inspection policy explicitly skipped, while keeping all normal structural checks.

assertions.description: Uses the skip policy only because the user explicitly requested it and clearly reports that no inspector security verdict was obtained.
Still enforces transport limits, path safety, strict skill validation, no-overwrite behavior, and transactional installation.

scenarios.prompt: Install this pinned third-party skill. I supplied a finalized APPROVE/ALLOW inspection report for the exact revision; verify it against the fetched bytes before installing.

assertions.description: Consumes only the explicitly supplied report and does not discover or trust a report included in the target.
Installs only after the report schema, target tree digest, completeness, scanner execution, semantic review, APPROVE verdict, and ALLOW gate all validate.

scenarios.prompt: The inspection report for this skill says CAUTION/PROMPT because it sends requested data to a documented API. Install it only if I have explicitly accepted that risk.

assertions.description: Blocks CAUTION/PROMPT by default and presents the documented risk for a user decision.
Uses allow-caution only after explicit acceptance and never treats it as an override for stale, incomplete, malformed, REJECT, BLOCK, HIGH, or CRITICAL evidence.

scenarios.prompt: I approved this third-party skill, then changed one line in its staged script. Go ahead and commit the old install plan with the old report.

assertions.description: Rehashes the candidate, rejects the stale report and plan state, installs nothing, and requires preparation plus inspection of the changed bytes.

scenarios.prompt: Install this unfamiliar skill even though its inspector report is missing coverage fields, the scanner failed, and semantic review is still pending.

assertions.description: Treats missing, malformed, error, incomplete, failed-execution, or pending-review evidence as a block and does not infer approval from scanner exit or score.
Does not silently install SkillSpector or another dependency to bypass the failed gate.

scenarios.prompt: Install these three skills as one batch. Two reports are APPROVE/ALLOW, but the third is REJECT/BLOCK. Do not leave a partial install.

assertions.description: Validates all selected skills, digests, and reports before creating any final destination.
One rejected gate blocks the entire batch, leaving zero selected skills installed.

scenarios.prompt: Inspect this already-downloaded agent skill for credential theft and excessive permissions, but do not install or change it.

assertions.description: Routes a standalone read-only security verdict to skill-inspector rather than skill-installer.

scenarios.prompt: Install pandas into my Python virtual environment.

assertions.description: Does not invoke the Codex skill installer for an ordinary Python package installation.
